mapper.select: SELECT om.order_id AS orderId, om.camp_id AS campId, om.status AS status, om.guest_name AS guestName, om.guest_mobile AS guestMobile FROM order_main om WHERE om.camp_id = #{campId} AND om.order_id = #{orderId} AND om.is_deleted = 0 FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE order_main SET status = #{status}, payment_status = COALESCE(#{paymentStatus}, payment_status), remark = COALESCE(#{remark}, remark), updated_at = NOW(), updated_by = #{userId}, version_no = version_no + 1 WHERE camp_id = #{campId} AND order_id = #{orderId} AND is_deleted = 0
